recommendation: Measure and optimize the environmental footprint of agent workloads
aws_service: AWS Sustainability / Amazon Bedrock AgentCore / Amazon Bedrock / Amazon CloudWatch
guidance: Without measurement, sustainability claims are aspirational and optimizations are not tracked against real-world data. Tracking the environmental footprint of agent workloads makes sustainability an engineering metric. Baselines show where effort is worth investing, and trends show whether changes are actually working.
how_to_check: • You have carbon emissions baselines for agent infrastructure established across a defined observation period. • Resource efficiency metrics for each task (tokens per successful completion, compute hours per workflow, and cache hit rates) are tracked alongside business outcomes. • Deferrable workloads are scheduled during off-peak periods or routed to Regions with favorable energy profiles. • Operational and sustainability metrics are combined in dashboards that inform periodic optimization reviews. For more information, see the AGENTSUS02-BP04 documentation.
